text:
zoe: Quick debrief from local evals for the candidate `rwd-v4p0-int4` vs prod `rwd-v3p1-int8`. Short TL;DR: cost down ~2.3x, P95 latency improved, but code slice shows small regression on multi-file completions. Needs canary gating discussion.

raj: sounds familiar. paste the top-level numbers pls.

zoe: Numbers (candidate vs prod):
- latency P50: -18ms
- latency P95: -45ms
- token cost: -57%
- doc-rewrite MRR: -0.6% abs
- QA exact-match: -0.4% abs
- code BLEU (multi-file): -1.8% abs (N=2200)

marta: sample size for code? confidence interval?

zoe: code N=2.2k, 95% CI ~ ±0.6% on BLEU. consistent drop concentrated on long functions and when imports span files. I dropped two repros in thread.

sam: any hallucination examples? a small repro would help triage.

zoe: posted two examples: one lost import ordering, another truncated helper function. both reproducible locally with same prompt/context.

opsbot: staging smoke: latency smoke passed, no OOMs. deploy-bot: small canary smoke (10k reqs) finished, KV hit rate normal.

raj: proposal: run staged canary: 5% for 24h, observe fidelity, hallucination, latency tail. auto-fallback if fidelity drop >1.0% abs, hallucination >0.5% abs, or P95 latency increase >25ms.

marta: given code BLEU -1.8, that would trip. suggest slice-aware gating: allow overall fidelity up to 0.8% if code-slice delta isolated and below 3.0% and we have mitigation plan.

sam: alternate flow: strict global thresholds but for code-slice deltas between 1.0% and 3.0% open a human-review window (1h) instead of immediate fallback. second breach within 6h => auto-fallback.

zoe: agree. propose rollout JSON (for the rollout system):

```
{\n  \"canary_fraction\": 0.05,\n  \"duration_hours\": 24,\n  \"metrics\": [\n    {\"name\": \"fidelity.overall.delta_abs\", \"threshold\": \"0.01\", \"action\": \"auto-fallback\"},\n    {\"name\": \"hallucination.qa.delta_abs\", \"threshold\": \"0.005\", \"action\": \"auto-fallback\"},\n    {\"name\": \"latency.p95.delta_ms\", \"threshold\": \"25\", \"action\": \"auto-fallback\"},\n    {\"name\": \"fidelity.slice.code_bleu.delta_abs\", \"threshold\": \"0.03\", \"action\": \"escalate-review\", \"reviewers\": [\"marta\",\"raj\"], \"grace_period_mins\": \"60\"}\n  ]\n}\n```

marta: add sampling rule to capture full request/response for code-slice failures (artifact upload + anonymize).

zoe: will persist full contexts for 1k code examples, PII redaction enabled.

opsbot: autoscaler note: canary will reserve 2x baseline GPU to avoid cold-start bias.

raj: also want a variance metric for token logprobs per session. soft alert if variance uplift >15% (no auto-fallback), surface on dashboard.

sam: will add variance tile and alert (ETA 6h). also recommend quiet-burn: if 5% x24h clean -> expand 25% x12h -> promote.

zoe: updated plan: 5% x24h -> 25% x12h -> 100% if clean. gating as above with review-first on code slice. I'll open rollout PR with repros and eval artifacts.

marta: please include a togglable prompt patch (2-3 targeted prompts) that can be enabled server-side if we see deterministic truncation.

zoe: noted. Action items: [1] zoe: PR + artifacts, [2] ops: pin canary capacity, [3] marta/raj: on-call for review, [4] sam: add variance metric/dashboard.

deploy-bot: rollout PR CI passed, canary job scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

zoe: thanks all, will ping when PR is live. :rocket:
